subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive scheduling for CloudBridge integration
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Durand <elaine.durand@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive scheduling for CloudBridge integration

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the discovery session earlier this week. Based on what we discussed (real-time inference for multi-tenant routing, KV cache persistence, and private networking constraints), it would be helpful to run a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with our solutions engineering team to align on integration approach and non-functional requirements.

Suggested agenda (flexible):
- 5m quick introductions and goals
- 15m recap of CloudBridge architecture and high-priority constraints (your side)
- 30m Redwood technical walkthrough: serving runtime, KV cache behavior, and recommended network topology
- 15m integration questions, next steps, and mutual action items

Who I'd bring: Marissa (SE lead) and Aditya (solutions engineer) — they can cover model serving, batching strategies, and secure connectivity.

Do any of these windows work on your side next week (PDT times):
- Tue 2027-04-06 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2027-04-07 11:00–12:30
- Thu 2027-04-08 13:00–14:30

If those don't fit, send a couple of options and we will accommodate. I've attached a short technical playbook we typically use as pre-read.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

— Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0113

Attachment: RBW-technical-playbook.pdf (PDF, 1.6MB)
From: Elaine Durand <elaine.durand@cloudbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive scheduling for CloudBridge integration

Jordan —

Thanks, this looks good. We spoke internally and want to make sure our network/security lead can join (Samir), plus one of our platform engineers. Our preferred slots (PDT):
- Wed 2027-04-07 11:00–12:00 (best)
- Thu 2027-04-08 10:00–11:30 (fallback)

Can you confirm the expected attendees and whether you'll share a short agenda and any pre-reads? Also, we have a short procurement/security checklist; Samir will flag any items that need follow-up.

Cheers,
Elaine Durand
VP, Platform Engineering | CloudBridge, Inc.
elaine.durand@cloudbridge.com
+1 415-555-2099
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-discovery: technical deep-dive scheduling for CloudBridge integration

Marissa / Aditya —

Elaine confirmed Wed 4/7 11:00–12:00 PDT as their preferred slot and wants Samir (security) + a platform engineer on the call. Please see below for the initial ask and agenda.

Prep checklist:
- Marissa: can you own the serving runtime walkthrough (KV cache behavior, batching SLOs)? Keep it to ~25–30m with slide deck.
- Aditya: please prepare a quick slide on networking/connectivity options (VPC peering vs. private link) and what we need from their side (firewall ports, CIDR ranges).
- We should also prepare a 1-slide summary of model quantization/latency tradeoffs for CloudBridge's multi-tenant workload.

Attachments to include in the invite: RBW-technical-playbook.pdf, network-topology.png, calendar invite ICS. I'll send the calendar once you confirm slides.

Thanks — Jordan

Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Technical deep-dive — Wed 2027-04-07 11:00–12:00 PDT (CloudBridge)

Hi Elaine / Samir —

Thanks — Wed 4/7 11:00–12:00 PDT works for our team. Confirmed attendees from Redwood:
- Jordan Blake (SE, meeting lead)
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineering)
- Aditya Rao (Network & Integration)

Attached: brief agenda and pre-reads (RBW-technical-playbook.pdf), a network topology snapshot we'll reference (network-topology.png), and a calendar invite (cloudbridge-integration-ics.ics).

Agenda (final):
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m CloudBridge architecture recap (CloudBridge)
- 30m Redwood technical walkthrough (Marissa & Aditya)
- 10m integration checklist & firewall/network action items
- 5m next steps & owners

Logistics: Zoom link will be the one in the calendar invite; please add any additional internal attendees who should join. If Samir wants to surface the procurement/security checklist ahead of time, we can map owners during the call.

Looking forward to it — I will send a calendar invite momentarily.

— Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
